feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump. And, Paramount settles in massive merger lawsuit
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. And, Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit over its massive Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

entry.title: Houthis try to push deeper into western Yemen, upending life, witnesses tell NPR
entry.summary: As the U.S. conflict with Iran drags, the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have opened a new front, taking new territory and displacing more than 100,000 people.

entry.title: New DNA analysis adds evidence Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings
entry.summary: A lock of hair, 15 years of sleuthing and a 200-year-old question. In History by a Hair, Smithsonian Institution scholar Richard Kurin follows the DNA trail back to Thomas Jefferson.

entry.title: AI solved one of math's hardest problems. Humanity learned nothing (so far)
entry.summary: OpenAI beat humans to solving the Navier-Stokes problem, but mathematicians say the AI's solution isn't telling them much.

entry.title: The House Freedom Caucus has to transform — it could preview the GOP's post-Trump era
entry.summary: The conservative House Freedom caucus grew in prominence along side President Trump, now they are considering what the future of their movement looks like.

entry.title: Abortion is on the ballot again as post-Roe policies continue to evolve
entry.summary: Four states will vote on abortion-related ballot measures in November. The measures follow the Supreme Court's "Dobbs" decision, which upended federal abortion protections.

entry.title: How unarmed 911 teams are reshaping public safety in nearly 100 cities
entry.summary: Alternative response programs, where mental health clinicians respond to 911 calls instead of police, have proliferated since George Floyd's murder. What does it take to do this work well?

entry.title: The best and biggest games of September
entry.summary: From Silent Hill: Townfall to Control Resonant to Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, we review the best new games to play as autumn begins, ahead of the titanic GTA6 release.

entry.title: Trump heads to U.N. looking for wins after a rough week
entry.summary: The past couple of weeks have been particularly challenging for Trump with a series of legal and political setbacks.

entry.title: Grand jury finds no evidence of criminal conduct in the death of Nolan Wells
entry.summary: A grand jury found Wells' cause of death "consistent with drowning," and decided not to bring indictments. The teenager was found dead on Horn Island, after he boated there with friends to celebrate Independence Day.
